difficultyRationale: Tests flow-sensitive scope of a pattern variable across short-circuit boolean operators.
prompt: Assume `obj` has type `Object`. Which condition validly uses pattern variable `s` on the right-hand side?
explanation: With `&&`, the right operand is evaluated only if the pattern match succeeded, so `s` is definitely matched there. With `||`, `|`, or `^`, the right operand can be evaluated when the pattern did not match.

options.explanation: The right side executes only after the String pattern matched, so `s` is in scope.
The right side can execute after the pattern fails, so `s` is not definitely matched there.
Non-short-circuit `|` evaluates the right operand regardless of whether the pattern matched.
The right operand is not guarded by successful pattern matching.

references.title: JLS 6.3.1 Scope of a Pattern Declaration
